prompt: Which comparison explains why there is no complete seven-year body replacement?

options.text: Different cells last days, months or decades
No cells are replaced after birth

explanation: Stomach surface cells and red cells turn over rapidly, while the research found neurons approximately as old as the person.

prompt: Does finding old neurons mean adults never produce new neurons?

options.text: No; neuron formation has been observed in the adult hippocampus
Yes; any finding applies to the entire brain
No; every neuron is replaced every four months

explanation: Results depend on the brain region and cell population studied. There is evidence of neuron formation in the adult hippocampus.
